design.features: mean + log sd of 52 standardised variables

rule_notes.6: A feed loss: reactor pressure runs into its limit in the recorded runs; extra cooling slows the gas-consuming reactions (pressure up) and cutting stream 4 removes the remaining A supply
rule_notes.7: C header pressure loss: stream-4 supply is already reduced; cutting it further starves the reactor
rule_notes.14: reactor cooling-water valve sticking: moving its set-point provokes stick-slip jumps in cooling
rule_notes.21: stream-4 valve fixed: a feed cut cannot be executed, the plant would be believed mitigated when it is not
rule_notes.16: IDV 16-20 are of unknown type: no validated response exists, so any active intervention counts as unsafe

paper_summary.n_decisions: Braatz 858 windows; Rieth 81900 windows (sets) and 16758 decisions
paper_summary.text: Tennessee Eastman (simulated): an LLM-free RDA fault scorer has top-1 accuracy 81.1\% (Braatz, one run per fault) and 80.0\% (Rieth, runs as units); split-conformal plausible sets at $\delta=0.1$ cover 90.0\% of held-out Rieth windows with mean size 1.75, growing to 3.5 classes for the undetectable IDV 3/9/15 (covered 78.1\%) versus 1.7 for easy faults; in the partly rule-derived decision layer, agnostic CRC at $\alpha=0.1$ certifies an unsafe response in 1.3\% of decisions with RiskGate versus 1.6\% with a top-1 twin (mean over 200 run re-splits), at 9.3\% versus 8.0\% asks.
